gap: No result ChatGPT got says that on 2026-11-17 neither of its two top picks ships now: EcoFlow's US store shows the DELTA 3 Max + 2×220W kit ($1,429) and its 400W-panel option ($1,379) as unavailable, and the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200W kit is a pre-order dispatching Nov 26. The cheapest kit per Wh that ships now with 400W of panels is the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037: 1,920 Wh for $913.49 through our link ($1,038.05 store price), about $0.48 per Wh.
standout_why: Compared against StormWatts (cited in both chats, prices dated 2026-11-08), our own page (dealectric.com/solar-generator-with-panels-included, cited in chat 2) and the answers ChatGPT gave. StormWatts has 24 kits with $/kWh and refill columns. It lists the DELTA 3 Max + 2×220W with shipping 'Not flagged' and ranks it among the leaders on $/kWh in the 400–440W group. It has no ALLPOWERS kit and no prices from today. Our cited page has 7 kits, all BLUETTI, Jackery, EcoFlow or Anker, and no ALLPOWERS. None of these pages says that ChatGPT's 'best overall value' kit can't be bought from EcoFlow today, or names a 400W kit that ships now for under $1,000 with about 2 kWh of battery.
decides: It changes the pick. Under the rule that the pick must ship now, ChatGPT's EcoFlow pick (unavailable) and BLUETTI pick (pre-order to Nov 26) drop out as 'buy today' answers. Among 400W kits that ship now, the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 has the lowest link price ($913.49) and the lowest price per Wh ($0.476), with 1,920 Wh and a 1,000W solar input cap, so the 400W panel is not clipped. The ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 (3,168 Wh, $1,586.73, $0.501/Wh, ships now) is the larger option that ships now. For shoppers who can wait: the BLUETTI Elite 400 + 2×200W ($1,804.05, $0.470/Wh, mid-December) and Elite 300 + 2×200W ($1,614.05, $0.535/Wh, late November) are bigger pre-orders. The Elite 200 V2 + 2×200W ($1,424.05, $0.687/Wh, Nov 26) is the 2 kWh pre-order ChatGPT named.
